acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated on in data-dependent acquisition mode (top 15 method).
cleavage agent: Trypsin solution (12.5 µg/ml stock in 20 mM ammonium bicarbonate) was added
enrichment method: immunoprecipitated endogenous, GFP-tagged BUB-1 from embryo lysates using a GFP nanobody
instrument: coupled with a Q-Exactive Plus Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization type: Sample was transferred to mass spectrometer via an Easy-Spray source
labeling: no labeling strategy mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
ptm: fixed Carbamidomethyl (C); variable acetyl (N-term); variable dioxidation (M); variable Gln to pyro-Glu (N-term Q); variable oxidation (M); variable deamidation (NQ); variable phosphorylation (STY)

Carbamidomethyl (C) was set as a fixed modification, and variable modifications were as follows: acetyl (N-term), dioxidation (M), Gln to pyro-Glu (N-term Q), oxidation (M), deamidation (NQ), and phosphorylation (STY).
reduction reagent: Samples were reduced with 10 mM DTT
reduction concentration: Samples were reduced with 10 mM DTT
